summary: A specific, well-built enemies-to-lovers romance where the lie-cold rule does real work: the midpoint confession, the 207th name in the count and the bond-end walk are moments readers will remember. A short revision round should fix a pre-empted betrothal beat, a bell continuity slip, a 'not a promise' tic, a flat Varun, a top-heavy hinge and a blurb line that confuses who the guide is.
